description: Revoke a link I made. Needs any of `bookings:write`, `payments:write`, `account:write`, `profile:write`, `content:write`, `inbox:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

name: revoke_link
title: Revoke a link I made
